name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Success
summary: Consumes one valid TOTP recovery code for the identified durable identity and completes the outstanding MFA requirement by establishing a normal authenticated application session.

guards.expression: the identified account has TOTP enabled and the submitted recovery code is valid and unused

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync validates and consumes one recovery code and can update MFA freshness when used as step-up.
Current recovery-code consumption is confirmed-user-only and requires orchestration normalization before it can establish an anonymous post-password sign-in session.
